To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a novel and efficient multifunctional flame-retardant was prepared and used in EVA resin.
a novel multifunctional flame-retardant based on brucite, APTES, and nickel alginate was successfully fabricated via the layer by layer assembly technique.
the B/A/Nia/A hybrid flame retardant has a multilayer structure, which is formed by the assembly of brucite, APTES, nickel alginate, and APTES.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fabrication of a novel multifunctional flame-retardant hybrid based on brucite, ionic liquid, and alginate.
the fabrication and application of the multifunctional bruecite/APTES/nickel alginate/APT (B/A/NiA/A) hybrid flame-retardant.
the development of a multifunctional flame-retardant hybrid flame retardant with excellent flame retardancy and smoke suppression and good mechanical performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the multifunctional B/A/Nia/A flame retardant was successfully fabricated and exhibited better comprehensive performance than brucites.
the multifunctional hybrid flame retardant based on B/A/Nia/A is a good choice for improving the fire safety and mechanical properties of EVA resin.
the hybrid flame retardants based on the layer-by-layer technique have a promising future in flame retardant applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the layer-by-layer technique could be used for the preparation of multifunctional flame-retarded materials, which could be a new strategy for the development of multifunctional materials.
the multifunctional hybrid flame retardant is promising in improving the flame, smoke suppression, mechanical, and thermal properties.
this study is the first report on the multifunctional B/A/Nia/A hybrid flame retardant, and it provides a new idea for the design of multifunctional flame retarded materials.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the multifunctional bruceite-based hybrid flame retardant has a great potential to improve the flame retardancy and smoke suppression of EVA and other polymer materials.
the layer-by-layer self-assembly technique can be used to construct multifunctional flame retarded materials with improved flame retardancy, mechanical properties, and smoke suppression.
the layer-by-layer technique is a facile and efficient method for fabricating a multifunctional flame-retardant hybrid material.
